# Release v3.1.0

<!-- Generated by cidx on 2026-08-08 10:01 -->
<!-- Edit this file to customize your release notes -->

## ⚠️ If you install cidx as a Go module, this is the release you want

v3.0.0 shipped with `go.mod` still declaring `github.com/cidx-org/cidx/v2`, so it
was not v3 of anything Go could resolve: `go list -m github.com/cidx-org/cidx/v3`
failed, and `go install github.com/cidx-org/cidx/v2/cmd/cidx@latest` — the line
`cidx generate github` writes into every bootstrapped workflow — quietly fetched
v2.4.0. Generated workflows were bootstrapping the previous major against a
config the v3 binary had validated (#395).

The module path is `github.com/cidx-org/cidx/v3` from this release on:

```bash
go install github.com/cidx-org/cidx/v3/cmd/cidx@latest
```

Regenerate your workflows (`cidx generate github`) so their bootstrap line
follows. Nothing else changes: v3.0.0 and v3.1.0 are the same CLI, and the
released binaries were never affected — only the Go module path was.

And the recurrence is closed rather than repaired: `cidx release tag create` now
refuses to tag `vN.0.0` when the module path's major is not N. #187 was this
same mismatch one major earlier, fixed by editing the path and leaving nothing
to catch the next one.

## ✨ Features

- **presets:** record the five DHI entrypoints, completing the catalogue (#397)
- **presets:** catch a command that hands its tool its own name, offline (#396)
- **monitor:** report a pinned tag nobody has republished in over a year (#393)
- **pr:** warn when the commit and the PR title disagree about what kind of change this is (#392)

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **release:** stop release create refusing the next release on its own leftover (#404)
- **release:** read BREAKING CHANGE as the footer it is, not as a substring (#403)
- **release:** move the module path to /v3 and refuse a major the path cannot publish (#401)
- **cli:** make a broken registry credential legible (#400)
- **artifact:** keep one run's evidence in a results directory, never two (#391)
- **monitor:** give a promotion PR a current baseline, and stop pr watch calling an empty check list green (#386)

## ♻️ Refactoring

- **test:** move the godog suite into features/ and the repository guards into internal/guards (#390)

## 🧪 Tests

- **pr:** hold cpw to failing before it commits when the remote is unusable (#394)

## 📦 Other Changes

- **monitor:** mint the promotion PR's token from a GitHub App (#388)
- **monitor:** open the promotion PR with a token that starts its checks (#387)
